answer: Cluster agents by correlated behaviour: the network logs timing, wording and wallet flows, and any agents whose traces move together like layers of shale get merged into one cluster that shares a single reward slot and vote. Like a pigment test that shows two paints share a copper base, the check reveals common control. An attacker must make each fake truly independent, with separate funds, schedules and skills, so a farm of puppets costs about as much as running real agents.
